extracted.intended_audience: Wolfram Language / Mathematica notebook users editing or styling notebooks
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for applying and managing cell/text styles in Wolfram Language (Mathematica) notebooks via the Format > Style menu and the Other dialog. Covers where styles come from, how to apply them to cells or text, and how to enter custom style names or option settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style assigns a style to selected cells or text
rubrics_metrics.description: Style assigns a style to selected cells or text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General statement of the menu item's purpose: use Style to apply a predefined style to whatever cells or text are selected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply style to cells via Style submenu
rubrics_metrics.description: To assign a style to one or more cells, select the cells and then choose the desired style name from the Style submenu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection must include the target cells; choose the style name from the submenu to apply that cell style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Styles are defined in the notebook's stylesheet
rubrics_metrics.description: The cell styles listed in the Style submenu are defined in the stylesheet assigned to your current notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Which styles appear in the menu depends on the notebook's active stylesheet; changing the stylesheet changes available styles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Default stylesheet for new notebooks
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathematica assigns a default stylesheet called Default to new notebooks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you haven't changed the stylesheet, the Style submenu reflects the styles defined in the Default stylesheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assign styles to individual words or characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Styles can also be assigned to individual words or characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You are not limited to whole-cell styling; select text within a cell to apply character-level styles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Other dialog to type a style name
rubrics_metrics.description: The Other dialog box lets you type in a style name to be assigned to the selected cell or text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the desired style name is not listed, you can manually enter a style name into the Other dialog to apply it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not all stylesheet styles must appear in the Style menu
rubrics_metrics.description: Not all styles defined in a stylesheet need to be listed in the Style menu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A stylesheet can define additional styles that are available programmatically or via Other even if they are not shown in the submenu.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assign cell options via typing option settings
rubrics_metrics.description: You can also assign cell options by typing the option setting in this dialog box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Other dialog accepts option-setting syntax, allowing you to set cell options directly rather than only selecting named styles.
